create_ViT_model: create a Vision Transformer model with parallel attention and feedforward branches for image classification
build_Transformer_encoder: build a Transformer encoder with multiple parallel attention and feedforward branches stacked in depth layers
create_Parallel_module: create a Parallel module that runs multiple sub-modules on the same input and sums their outputs
build_Attention_block: build a multi-head self-Attention block with LayerNorm, QKV projection, and dropout for transformer layers
create_FeedForward_block: create a FeedForward block with LayerNorm, linear layers, GELU activation, and dropout for transformer feedforward
